description.value: everything WINE is a BC-based specialty wine and spirits retail chain offering a broad selection of wines organized by varietal, region, and occasion, alongside beer, cider, and spirits. The Chilliwack location at McCallum Road is part of the company's multi-store footprint serving the Fraser Valley. The store stocks a curated range of local BC wines alongside international selections, and offers a wine club and event consultation services.
